summary: Phase R-MARKET-1B / E-2 / E-3 FINAL INTEGRATED TEST — FULL PASS. Backend: 58/58 existing tests still green (test_phase_r_market_1a, test_phase_r_market_1b_locale_wiring, test_phase_e_1a_editorial, test_phase_e_1b_studio, test_phase_e2_p2_editorial_public — NO regression from Prompt 3). New Prompt 3 suite (test_phase_e3_p3_seo_locale.py, 6 tests, 4 passed + 2 conditionally skipped on calendar coverage): public editorial endpoint emits article.slug_map_by_locale dict (loc→variant_slug) for all PUBLISHED sibling variants, _source=editorial_variant, _locale.source=editorial_variant, _locale.preview=false for anonymous even with ?preview=1, internal_translation never serialised (key absent + raw-text leak negative), unknown slug 404 with ?preview=1 (anonymous cannot unlock drafts), GET /api/editorial/variants/{id}/internal-translation → 401 anon. Frontend: /it-IT/magazine/warm-italian-gcc-luxury → ArticleHead emits exactly 1 canonical (data-mfd-head=canonical, owned by ArticleHead, NOT LocaleHead — confirms LocaleHead.isArticleDetail() correctly defers), canonical points to /<served_locale>/magazine/<localized-slug> = /en-AE/magazine/warm-italian-gcc-luxury (served falls back to en-AE since only en-AE variant is published — correct behaviour), hreflang per slug_map entry pointing to localized URLs, x-default → canonical, og:type=article, og:locale=en_AE, og:url/title/description/image, twitter:card=summary_large_image, JSON-LD schema.org/Article with headline+description+inLanguage+mainEntityOfPage+image+datePublished+dateModified+author+publisher, robots='index, follow' on normal request. On ?preview=1: ed-preview-banner sticky bar renders at top with Italian copy 'PREVIEW · INTERNAL · NON INDICIZZATA' + 'ESCI DALLA PREVIEW' exit link (target href drops ?preview=1, uses replace), meta robots flips to 'noindex, nofollow'. All Prompt 1 (locale routing/hreflang allow-list/x-default/legacy canonical/og:locale per supported locale + no SEO on /en-AE,/pt-BR,/auth) and Prompt 2 (Editorial Studio split-pane, tabs strict semantics, autosave PATCH, toolbar verbs) regressions remain green per backend pytest suite.
